judge.rationale: The candidate delivers every single acceptance criterion in the issue, including the explicit test for static schema compilation across ten `execute` calls that the reference diff actually omitted. All documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` with spec links) and implementation details (static compile on register, WeakMap cache for dynamic schemas, safe error formatting without leaking values) are spot-on. The main differences from the reference are promoting the already-present `ajv@^6.15.0` from `package-lock.json` instead of upgrading to `ajv@^8.17.1`, and leaving behind `.lore/dod.md` and duplicate `.acceptance.test.ts` files alongside the requested unit test files.
